verdict.rationale: Google documents a zero-data-retention path for Gemini model usage: customers can turn off prompt logging for abuse monitoring, data caching, grounding logs and the 24-hour Live API session-resumption cache. However, that documentation sits on the Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform surface rather than the core Gemini API docs, and the API docs note implicit caching is on by default. Missing for 10: retention/deletion controls documented directly for the Gemini API (ai.google.dev) surface, explicit user-initiated deletion of stored prompts/files/logs, configurable retention periods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
